recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If CDS/FHIR-I wants statistical, dataset, or net-effect to be valid Group.combinationMethod codes in the current model, that should be handled as a current Group/EvidenceVariable tracker rather than as a missing FHIR-36779 application.
issue_request: FHIR-36779 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding 'statistical' and 'dataset' to the CharacteristicCombination value set for EvidenceVariable, plus changing 'net-effect' to mean addition of benefits and subtraction of harms.
initial_application: April 2022 Jira-tagged commits 878eb1abe3c41c689adf4a936c8e9d1d3e6068ae and 09556cea5c81778c7023ffc771f9b1e86f9754bd, merged through PR #1902, added the requested CodeSystem concepts, updated the net-effect definition, and updated the old EvidenceVariable.characteristic.defByCombination.code short description.
additional_context: R6 follow-up work changed the model. FHIR-41583 added Group.combinationMethod for conceptual cohort/group definitions, and FHIR-42886 removed EvidenceVariable.characteristic and the EvidenceVariable-specific CharacteristicCombination value set in favor of EvidenceVariable.definition as a CodeableReference to Group. The current Group value set is scoped to Group.combinationMethod and intentionally excludes the EvidenceVariable-specific statistical, dataset, and net-effect semantics, while the CodeSystem still carries those concepts.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-adding statistical or dataset to the current required Group.combinationMethod value set would be a new R6 Group semantics decision, not completion of the removed R5 EvidenceVariable binding targeted by FHIR-36779.
